reference: If she hadn't invited them all, she wouldn't be this annoyed now.
sk: Keby ich všetkých nepozvala, teraz by nebola taká nahnevaná.
cz: Kdyby je všechny nepozvala, teď by nebyla tak naštvaná.
acceptable: If she hadn't invited {them all|all of them}, she wouldn't be {this|so} {annoyed|angry|irritated} now.
She wouldn't be {this|so} {annoyed|angry|irritated} now if she hadn't invited {them all|all of them}.
If she hadn't invited {them all|all of them}, she wouldn't now be {this|so} {annoyed|angry|irritated}.

mistakes.text: If she didn't invite them all, she wouldn't be this annoyed now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pozvanie bolo v minulosti, preto po „if“ patrí Past Perfect: „hadn't invited“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pozvání bylo v minulosti, proto po „if“ patří Past Perfect: „hadn't invited“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The inviting was in the past, so the if-clause needs the Past Perfect: “hadn't invited”.

mistakes.text: If she hadn't invited them all, she wouldn't have been this annoyed now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Hnev trvá teraz („now“), preto v Mixed Conditional: „wouldn't be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Naštvání trvá teď („now“), proto v Mixed Conditional: „wouldn't be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The annoyance is about now, so the Mixed Conditional needs “wouldn't be”, not “wouldn't have been”.

mistakes.text: If she wouldn't have invited them all, she wouldn't be this annoyed now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; správne je Past Perfect: „if she hadn't invited“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; správně je Past Perfect: „if she hadn't invited“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; use the Past Perfect: “if she hadn't invited”.

mistakes.text: If she hadn't invited all them, she wouldn't be this annoyed now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Správne je „them all“ alebo „all of them“, nie „all them“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Správně je „them all“ nebo „all of them“, ne „all them“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Say “them all” or “all of them”, not “all them”.

mistakes.text: If she hadn't invited them all, she wouldn't be such annoyed now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred samotným prídavným menom patrí „so“ alebo „this“, nie „such“: „so annoyed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před samotným přídavným jménem patří „so“ nebo „this“, ne „such“: „so annoyed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Before an adjective on its own use “so” or “this”, not “such”: “so annoyed”.
